reports.title: Western Union Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is updating the financial outlook for full year 2026. Our outlook assumes no material changes in macroeconomic conditions, including changes in immigration policies, foreign currencies, Argentina inflation, or any prolonged impact or escalations of the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.

2026 Outlook Including Intermex1 | 2026 Outlook Excluding Intermex2
GAAP | Adjusted | GAAP | Adjusted
Revenue3 | 0% to 1% | 0% to 1% | (2)% to (1)% | (2)% to (1)%
EPS4 | NA5 | $1.28 to $1.38 | NA5 | $1.28 to $1.38
1 “2026 Outlook Including Intermex” includes an assumption that the Intermex transaction closes on November 10th, 2026.
2 “2026 Outlook Excluding Intermex” assumes the Intermex transaction does not close during fiscal year 2026.
3 Adjusted revenue growth excludes the impact of currency and Argentina inflation in quarters when hyperinflationary (over 50% within a quarter).
4 The GAAP effective tax rate is expected to be 20% to 22% and the adjusted effective tax rate is expected to be 10% to 12%.
